segments.text: Listening Test In the listening test, you will be asked
to demonstrate how well you understand spoken English.
The entire listening test will last approximately 45 minutes.
There are four parts and directions are given for each part.
You must mark your answers on the separate answer sheet.
Do not write your answers in your test book.
Part 1.
Directions For each question in this part, you will
hear four statements about a picture in your test book.
When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what
you see in the picture.
Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer.
The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Now part 1 will begin.
Number 1.
Look at the picture marked number 1 in your test book.
A. Some pictures are mounted on a wall, B. A man is hanging up a picture, C. A rug is
being rolled up, D. A lamp is standing on the floor.
Number 2.
Look at the picture marked number 2 in your test book.
A. He's installing a door, B. He's watering some plants, C. He's trimming ahead.
D. He's sweeping a patio.
Number 3. Look at the picture marked number 3 in your test book.
A. The sidewalk is covered with leaves, B. Some bushes are being trimmed, C. Some workers are
washing a window, D. A van is being loaded.
Number 4. Look at the picture marked number 4 in your test book.
A. There's sitting on a bench, B. There's spreading a blanket on the grass, C.
They're folding an umbrella, D. They're carrying a basket.
Number 5. Look at the picture marked number 5 in your test book.
A. A man is reading a document, B. A woman is answering a telephone, C.
They're shaking hands across a counter, D. They're stacking boxes on a cart.
Number 6. Look at the picture marked number 6 in your test book.
A. He's looking into a microscope, B. He's typing on a keyboard, C.
He's opening a drawer, D. He's talking on a phone.
Part 2. Directions.
You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English.
They will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Select the best response to the question or statement and mark the letter A, B, or C on your answer sheet.
Now, let us begin with question number 7.
Number 7.
Would you be interested in coming along with our cycling group this Saturday morning?
A. Sure, that would be great.
B. About 20 miles altogether.
C. A brand new road bike.
Number 8.
Is my cleaning appointment this Friday or next Friday?
A. It's this Friday at 9 in the morning.
B. The same hygienist as last time.
C. Please take the next available seat.
Number 9.
Aren't the new fairgates already fully contactless?
A. I haven't ridden that line yet.
B. The doors close pretty quickly on this platform.
C. No, just a single ride pass please.
Number 10.
Why did you move this afternoon's lessons to a later time?
A. At 4 o'clock instead.
B. He printed the new schedules.
C. The main room was still in use.
Number 11.
Do you want to book the early morning flight or the one in the late afternoon?
A. Yes, that would be great.
B. From the main terminal.
C. I'm still waiting to hear back about the meeting time.
Number 12.
Where can I get some water for my bottle?
A. Fill it up at the stands near gate 5.
B. A large plastic bottle.
C. Just before we board.
Number 13.
Vivian's coordinating the wedding order, right?
A. The colors really coordinate well.
B. No, Denise's.
C. There's plenty of food left over.
Number 14.
Do you like the new lunch menu in the cafeteria?
A. Yes, the lunch went really well.
B.
No, I'm not too impressed, honestly.
C. The cafe is just down the hall.
Number 15.
Could you water the plants in the greenhouse this afternoon?
A. The weather's been really dry lately.
B. I'm leaving at noon today.
C. By the back entrance.
Number 16.
Let me know when the shipment gets here so I can help you move the boxes.
A. Those boxes are really heavy.
B. She's down in the loading area.
C. Gabriel's already taking care of it.
Number 17.
Have we finished resurfacing the lanes before we open?
A. Yes, the crew wrapped up that job about an hour ago.
B. When exactly do we open to the public today?
C. They're right behind the shoe rental counter.
Number 18.
What flavor would you like me to add to your drink?
A. As soon as the machine's free?
B. Yes, that's a big favor, thanks.
C. I'd love some caramel, thanks.
Number 19.
Did you buy the annual movie membership?
A. Yes, right at the start of the year.
B. I've already found my seat.
C. I'm reading the manual now.
Number 20.
How long has the packing machine been out of service?
A. I'm afraid I don't have any free time.
B.
The machine's just past the loading area.
C. Close to two days now.
Number 21.
Why don't we haul the kayaks up before the tide comes in?
A. The hole is being repainted this week.
B. Actually, I've already started on that.
C. Because the tide's higher than usual.
Number 22.
Would you like me to arrange delivery for your table?
A. No thanks, I'd rather load it into my car.
B. They delivered the results this morning.
C. She's really good at her job.
Number 23.
Here are some color swatches for you to choose from.
A. It opens at nine tomorrow.
B. My watch needs a new battery.
C. Let me look through them first.
Number 24.
Are these lenses single vision or bifocal?
A. Yes, I renewed my license last week.
B. They're single vision.
C. About $90 altogether.
Number 25.
Who's presenting the station's new evening program?
A. A present for the top listener.
B. Bernard's being picked for it.
C. Every weekday at seven.
Number 26.
You're fixing the brakes on that car, right?
A. That was a close game last night.
B. No, it's the second door on the left.
C. Yes, it's just about finished.
Number 27.
Which segment of the documentary do you think we should start editing first?
A. The client hasn't approved anything yet.
B. My computer wouldn't start up this morning.
C. He's directing the next project.
Number 28.
Could you email the supplier to confirm the amount on this invoice?
A.
Sure, the file room downstairs.
B. They ship every Thursday.
C. I'm busy until noon.
Number 29.
When will my dress be ready for pickup?
A. You could address that at the counter.
B. We just have a few buttons left to sew on.
C. Right by the pickup window.
Number 30.
We're setting off early Saturday for the group hike.
A. Did they reach the top?
B. Just two water bottles.
C. I already have weekend plans.
Number 31.
The clinic switched to sending appointment reminders by text instead of by phone, didn't it?
A. They upgraded their whole system last month?
B. I'd like a later appointment, please.
C. Could you remind me of the address?
Part 3.
Directions. You will hear some conversations between two or more people.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet.
The conversations will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Questions 32-34 refer to the following conversation.
Hi, I'm Elias Moreno from Sales.
I'm dropping off the receipts from our three-day sales meeting in Torrington.
Four of them.
Welcome, but we don't take the paper packet anymore.
Since the first of this month, everything goes through our new online system, ExpenseLink.
The cutoff date is still the 15th, same as before.
Oh, I hadn't heard.
Could you take the paper copies just this once?
I have a meeting at two.
I could type them in for you, but you should do your own first entry.
You'll need it every month.
The login is on the staff page.
Thanks, but I'd rather learn it myself.
I'll enter the receipts online right after my meeting before I leave today.
That works. I'll look for it this evening.
Number 32.
Why has the man come to see the woman?
Number 33.
According to the woman, what has recently changed?
Number 34.
What does the man say he will do before he leaves today?
Questions 35-37 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Hi, I'd like to reserve some kayaks for a group outing during our lake trip this Saturday.
There are eight of us.
Sure, thanks for calling Pinecrest boat rentals, so that's eight single kayaks for Saturday.
Let me check with my colleague who keeps the schedule.
I'm sorry, but all of our single kayaks are already fully booked for that day.
Oh, that's a shame.
Is there anything else we could use?
Well, we still have several two-person canoes free, so I can set aside four of those for your group instead.
That sounds great.
Let's go with the canoes.
Number 35.
Why is the woman calling?
Number 36.
What problem does the man mention?
Number 37.
What does the man offer to do?
Questions 38-40 refer to the following conversation.
Hi, I'd like to bring my bicycle on the next departure to the North Shore.
I have to be there by two o'clock for a meeting, so the sooner the better.
Welcome to Red Cliff Ferry.
Let me check for you.
Unfortunately, the bicycle spaces on that sailing are already fully booked, and I can see you're in a real hurry.
But here's some good news.
There's an earlier boat leaving in about 20 minutes, and it still has room for bikes.
It arrives well before two, so I can book you onto that one right now if you'd like.
Number 38.
Who most likely is the woman?
Number 39.
What does the man say he needs to do?
Number 40.
What does the woman offer to do?
Questions 41-43 refer to the following conversation.
Julian, thanks so much for coming in this morning.
We're really glad Apaturline portraits could take the staff photos for our new website.
Happy to be here.
Before we start, could you bring the team together in the conference room?
I'll set up the lighting and background while you round everyone up.
Of course.
I'll gather everyone right now.
There are eight of us, and I emailed you the name list yesterday.
Great.
I got it.
Hmm.
One thing, though.
The list has everyone's names, but their job titles aren't included, and I need those for the captions.
Could you send them over?
Number 41.
Why has the man come to the office?
Number 42.
What does the man ask the woman to do?
Number 43.
What does the man point out about the list?
Questions 44-46 refer to the following conversation.
Hi.
Good morning.
I'm looking for work, and a friend suggests that I come in and register with your agency for some placement help.
Welcome.
You've come to the right place.
Once you register, I'll get to know your background and match you with employers who are hiring.
And here's what makes us really useful.
A lot of the openings we fill are never advertised publicly, so you'll hear about roles you couldn't find on your own.
Oh, that's really helpful.
My resume isn't quite finished, though.
Would it be all right if I used one of your computers here to update it before we start?
Absolutely.
No problem.
Take that desk in the corner, and once you're done, we'll fill out your registration together.
Number 44.
Where most likely does the man work?
Number 45.
What benefit does the man mention about the service?
Number 46.
What does the woman ask permission to do?
Questions 47-49 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning, Elmwood Collection Services. How can I help you?
Hi. I'd like to arrange a pickup for two large items, an old refrigerator and a couch I'm getting rid of.
Certainly. We can collect those next Thursday. There's a fee of $10 per item, so 20 in total.
That's fine. I should mention, though, the refrigerator is extremely heavy, and I live alone.
No need to worry. Our crew handles all the lifting themselves.
I'll send you a confirmation email with the day and the address details.
Wonderful. Thank you so much for your help.
Number 47.
Why is the woman calling?
Number 48.
What does the woman imply when she says, the refrigerator is extremely heavy, and I live alone?
Number 49.
What does the man say he will do?
Questions 50-52 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning, Miss Pell. I'd like to attend the Regional Marketing Summit next month.
Oh, that's a great idea, Warren. Building your skills is just what we want.
Thanks. The sessions on new campaign strategies would really benefit our whole team.
Definitely. For an extra $200, you could add the hands-on workshop day. Shall I include that?
Hmm. Well, our department funds are pretty tight this quarter.
I understand completely. The main summit is still approved, so go ahead and register.
Great. One question. Do I need to submit my receipts before I'm reimbursed for the travel?
Yes. Just turn them in within a week, and finance will handle the rest.
Number 50.
What does the man want to do?
Number 51.
Why does the man say our department funds are pretty tight this quarter?
Number 52.
What does the man ask the woman about?
Questions 53-55 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Come in. Welcome.
I'm Hannah, and this is my business partner, Rosa.
We've been looking over the concepts you sent through.
Thank you both. I'm Everett, and I design websites and brand materials for small businesses.
I've been developing those layouts all week.
Great. So Hannah and I run a yoga studio together, and we're really hoping the new site will bring in more members.
That's exactly what I aimed for.
This first concept puts your class photos right at the top to draw people in.
Oh, I love that. It feels warm and inviting.
Perfect.
One thing I need to know, when would you like the site ready to launch?
By the first of March, ideally, before our spring sign-up period begins.
Number 53.
What most likely is the man's occupation?
Number 54.
What kind of business do the women run?
Number 55.
What does the man ask the woman about?
Questions 56-58 refer to the following conversation.
Mr. Osborne, I'm Rosalind from Vertex Lift Services.
I'm here to arrange the annual servicing for the building's elevators.
Nice to meet you. I should mention, though, our lobby gets very busy every morning,
so shutting an elevator down during work hours would really slow everyone down.
I understand completely.
The good news is, we can finish the whole job in about six hours.
I'd suggest we carry it out on a Saturday, when the building is mostly empty.
That sounds sensible.
Before I confirm a date, though, could you send me a written cost estimate?
I'll need to run it by the property owner first.
Number 56.
What are the speakers mainly discussing?
Number 57.
What does the woman suggest?
Number 58.
What does the man ask for?
Questions 59-61 refer to the following conversation.
Thanks for calling Copper Top Linen Supply. This is Vera. How can I help you today?
Hi. I manage Harvest Table Bistro, and I'd like to set up regular rental and cleaning
of our table cloths and napkins for the dining room.
Of course. For a place your size, I'd recommend our scheduled service.
We collect your used linens once a week, and drop off freshly laundered replacements at the very same time.
That sounds workable.
My one worry is the weekends. We get extremely busy, and I'm not sure a single weekly delivery
would leave us with enough clean linens to get through the rush.
Number 59.
What type of business does the man most likely run?
Number 60.
What does the woman recommend?
Number 61.
What is the man concerned about?
Questions 62-64 refer to the following conversation and map.
Good morning, and welcome to the Ashcomb Events House.
May I ask who you are and what you're delivering today?
Of course. I'm Damon Reyes. I run a flower shop, and I've brought all the arrangements for the wedding this afternoon.
They're fairly tall, so I really need to know exactly which room to set them up in.
Let me check the floor plan for you. Your wedding is in the third hall from the main entrance.
The one directly below the garden terrace.
Got it. Thank you. And where should I leave my van while I unload everything?
Here's a parking permit for the lot. Just use the side entrance on your right, and someone will come help you carry things in.
Number 62.
What type of business does the man most likely run?
Number 63.
Look at the graphic. Which hall is the wedding in?
Number 64.
What does the woman give the man?
Question 65-67 refer to the following conversation and chart.
Good morning, Theo. I'm so sorry. I emailed everyone the wrong version of the schedule yesterday.
Did it cause any confusion?
Don't worry. I sent a correction right away. But we do have a bigger problem.
The projector in the willow room has stopped working.
Oh no. Then we'll have to move that session to a different room. I'll figure out where.
Sounds good. Also, the caterer still needs a final head count before 11 o'clock.
Right. Can you call them with the number? Meanwhile, I'll update the signs on all the doors.
Number 65.
Why does the woman apologize?
Number 66.
Look at the graphic. Which session will most likely be moved?
Number 67.
What will the man most likely do next?
Question 68-70 refer to the following conversation and list.
Welcome to Ridgeline Cycles. Can I help you find something today?
Yes, I'm looking for a new bike. My current one is just too heavy. I'm honestly tired of lifting it around.
I completely understand. And where do you normally ride?
Mostly on rough dirt paths through the woods near my house. There are lots of bumps and loose uneven ground.
In that case, take a look at this printed list. Each model is matched to a type of riding, so one of them will suit you perfectly.
That's really helpful. So, which one should I go with?
Let me check your size in the back and bring that one out for you to try.
Number 68.
What does the man say about his current bicycle?
Number 69.
Look at the graphic. Which model will the man most likely buy?
Number 70.
What will the woman most likely do next?
Part 4.
Directions.
You will hear some talks given by a single speaker.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The talks will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Question 71 through 73 refer to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Hi Gerald. I've just finished going through the results of the customer feedback survey we sent out last month,
and overall the numbers are really encouraging.
Most people said they're happy with our frame selection and the service they get here in the shop.
There was one thing that came up again and again though.
A lot of customers complained about long wait times when they called to book an appointment.
I think the phone line simply gets too busy in the afternoons.
So I'd like to suggest hiring an additional employee to handle those calls.
Could you help me put together a proposal for the manager?
Number 71.
What is the speaker mainly discussing?
Number 72.
What did some customers complain about?
Number 73.
What does the speaker suggest doing?
Question 74 through 76 refer to the following advertisement.
Are you looking for a better way to keep your pet looking its best?
Come and visit willopop pet grooming salon right here in town.
Every one of our groomers is fully certified and highly experienced.
You can trust that your pet is always in caring expert hands.
And as a special welcome, all first time customers receive a free nail trim with their appointment.
Our schedule fills up quickly, especially on weekends.
So spaces are limited.
So don't wait.
Call us today to reserve a time that suits you.
Number 74.
What does the speaker say about the salon's groomers?
Number 75.
According to the speaker, what do first time customers receive?
Number 76.
What does the speaker urge listeners to do?
Question 77 through 79 refer to the following excerpts from a talk.
Good evening and welcome to our six week course here at the Fernbroke Learning Center.
Over these sessions, we'll focus on managing your personal finances, how to track what you spend and plan ahead with confidence.
Each week, I'll hand out a short worksheet and we'll work through it together.
Before our next meeting, I'd like each of you to create a weekly schedule mapping out where your money goes.
Now, if that sounds intimidating, don't worry.
I struggled with this myself when I first started.
Believe me, it gets much easier over time.
Next time, we'll look at simple ways to set savings goals.
Number 77.
What is the course mainly about?
Number 78.
What does the speaker ask the listeners to do before the next class?
Number 79.
Why does the speaker say, I struggled with this myself when I first started?
Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following broadcast.
And now for our weekly local business update.
Larkfield Farmers Market, a favorite with shoppers here for over a decade, is moving to a larger site in the town center.
The new location on Bexley Street offers room for 80 vendor stalls, nearly double what the current lot can hold.
Organizers say the move was needed to accommodate the growing number of visitors who show up each weekend.
To mark the occasion, an opening day celebration is planned, with live music and free food samples.
So, if you'd like to join in, just head down to the new Bexley Street site this Saturday morning.
Number 80.
What kind of business is being reported on?
Number 81.
Why is the business relocating?
Number 82.
How does the speaker suggest listeners take part?
Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following talk.
As front desk assistants here at Maple Britt Clinic, one of your main duties is checking in patients as soon as they arrive at the counter.
This step is important because it lets our nurses and doctors know right away that a patient is waiting for an appointment.
When someone walks up, greet them, find their name on the screen in front of you and confirm their appointment time.
Once you've done that, a green check mark will appear next to their name, which means they've been successfully checked in.
Now, let me introduce you to the rest of the team you'll be working with.
Number 83.
Where most likely are the listeners?
Number 84.
According to the speaker, why is this step important?
Number 85.
What will the listeners most likely do next?
Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following telephone message.
Hi Greta.
This is Roman Whitfield, calling from Cordell Appliances, where a company that designs and produces kitchen appliances at our own factory here in town.
And I wanted to tell you about our newest item, the Breeze Blend Mini Compact Blender.
Actually, yesterday, our sales figures showed the demand for this little blender has risen sharply over the past month, so I really think it would be a great fit for the shelves at your store.
It's lightweight, quiet, and very affordable.
Now, I should mention that these units tend to sell out quickly, so I'd hate for you to miss the chance to stock them.
Please give me a call back when you get this message.
Number 86.
What type of business does the speaker work for?
Number 87.
What did the speaker find out yesterday?
Number 88.
Why does the speaker say these units tend to sell out quickly?
Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following excerpt from a recorded instructional video.
Hello, and welcome to Brightlock Self Storage.
Thank you for renting a unit with us.
We're really glad to have you as a customer.
One thing our renters especially appreciate is that every unit is kept at a steady temperature all year round, so your belongings stay safe from heat and humidity.
In this short video, I'll show you how to reach your unit on your very first visit.
Before you come by, I strongly recommend downloading our mobile app.
With it, you can open the entrance gate right from your phone, so you won't have to stop and type a code at the panel every single time.
Number 89.
What has the listener recently done?
Number 90.
According to the speaker, what is one advantage of the facility?
Number 91.
What does the speaker recommend?
Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following broadcast.
Good morning, and welcome to the Weekend Arts Hour here on Millbrook Community Radio.
I'm your host, Gloria Hartman.
Our top story today, a brand new photography exhibition has just opened at the Pelham Art Museum downtown.
The collection is the work of local photographer Ruth Halverson, who spent the past three years traveling along our coast.
Now, what makes this show truly special is that nearly every photograph was taken under water, something you rarely see in a gallery.
The exhibition opens to the public this Saturday, and admission is completely free for the first two weeks.
So do plan a trip soon, because it only runs through the end of the month.
Number 92.
What is the broadcast mainly about?
Number 93.
What does the speaker say is unusual about the exhibition?
Number 94.
Why does the speaker say it only runs through the end of the month?
Questions 95 through 97 refer to the following announcement and schedule.
Before we finish today's session here at Grove Point Fitness Center, I have a couple of program updates.
First, we're launching a series of guest classes this week, and the full schedule is posted on the board near the entrance.
One of them has already filled up quickly, so our Tuesday class will now run a second time on Friday as well, so please book early if you'd like a spot.
Next, I'd like to introduce Rebecca Cole, our newest fitness instructor.
She'll be observing classes this week, and will begin leading her own sessions next week.
I've also placed a sign-up sheet at the front desk, so please add your name before you leave today.
Thank you all.
Number 95.
Look at the graphic.
Which class will be offered on two days this week?
Number 96.
Who is Rebecca Cole?
Number 97.
What has the speaker placed at the front desk?
Questions 98 through 100 refer to the following advertisement and chart.
Is your living room carpet looking dull and tired?
At Meadowbrook Carpet Care, we bring your floors back to life again.
Our cleaning teams are fully trained, and we only use gentle products that are safe for children and pets.
We offer four different cleaning plans to suit every home, so just take a look at the chart to compare them.
This month, our plan that covers up to four rooms is available for a special price of only $79, well below the usual rate.
Don't miss out on this deal.
To claim it, simply book your appointment online at our website before the end of the month.
Number 98.
What type of business is being advertised?
Number 99.
Look at the graphic.
Which cleaning plan is being offered at a special price?
Number 100.
According to the speaker, how can listeners claim the offer?
